notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The One Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.
